title: The Madwoman of Chaillot
writer: Jean Giraudoux, Maurice Valency, Edward Anhalt
actors: Katharine Hepburn, Charles Boyer, Claude Dauphin
plot: Nice, eccentric, idealistic and slightly mad Countess Aurelia, who believes that the good must prevail over evil, decides to stand up to corrupt powerful leaders of Paris by putting them on trial with 'unwashed masses' as the jury.
